headlines.title: The business mistake McDonald's and Chipotle keep making: Robert Irvine
headlines.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how he helped push through the legislative change that's replacing 50-year-old Army mess halls with campus-style dining

headlines.title: Is DoorDash (DASH) Undervalued Following Its New Lyft Partnership?
headlines.summary: DoorDash (DASH) is back in focus after Lyft announced Lyft Go, a new membership that links directly with DashPass and lets riders earn credits redeemable for both rides and DoorDash orders. Set against this new Lyft tie-up, DoorDash’s share price has eased in recent months, with a 30 day share price return of down 6.05% and a 90 day move down 16.92%, even as the 3 year total shareholder return of 105.41% points to strong longer term momentum.

headlines.title: Booking vs. DoorDash: Does Going Out or Staying In Make One Stock a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Booking's cash machine versus DoorDash's rapid share gains set up a clear trade-off for 2027, with valuation tilting the scales in an unexpected direction.

headlines.title: DoorDash Rose 13% in a Week. Is the $17 Billion Instacart Deal Really That Good?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash (DASH) stock gained 13% from October 26 to November 2, outperforming the Nasdaq 100 ETF’s roughly 4% decline after record quarterly earnings and a major acquisition announcement. Instacart (CART) agreed to be acquired for approximately $17 billion, bringing DoorDash grocery delivery capabilities and a valuable advertising business.

headlines.title: Amazon Gives Prime Members Uber Eats, Opening a New Front Against DoorDash
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAmazon and Uber now give US Prime members $0 delivery fees on Uber Eats restaurant orders of $25 or more placed through Amazon. The perk puts DoorDash’s main rival in front of Prime households at no extra cost, straight at the DashPass subscriptions DoorDash relies on.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
